interpretation.hypothesis_scope: Unity-pattern checks distinguish candidates without fitting thresholds; consistent does not mean uniquely established.
interpretation.bracket_condition: Assumes monotonic single transition; upper bound is historical, not a new run.
other_unexcluded_hypotheses: Other reporting floors or numerical branches
interpretation.normalization: All archived endpoints reconstruct CND as |Vtotal|^2/(2*50); raw P uses actual spectral Z. This is an algebraic observation, not proof of internal implementation.
interpretation.not_bypass: Nonzero exported device noise and attenuated DCP persist while CGAIN/CNF equal unity.
interpretation.still_open: Origin of near-zero effective transport/device-noise errors and exact reporting transition.
